$schema_note: Hand-curated record of what is known about when a key dungeon's end chest (Dungeon_Chest_obj) opens, NOT mechanically extracted (see hs-game-sdk/curated/satanic_zone.json for why curated/ exists). Data only: no binding is generated from this file, and hs_game_sdk/dungeon_chest_model.py never reads it; tests/test_dungeon_chest_model.py reads both and checks that the model reproduces each entry, and that each of the model's HYPOTHESES stays None until a `measured` entry names it in `hypothesis` and carries `values.verdict` (true or false). The mechanism, in our own words, is docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md. Every entry has `id` (DC1, DC2, ...), `kind` (`baseline` = vanilla, no lever; `target` = a ForgePact lever applied; `our_code` = a contract of ForgePact's own code, not the game), `status` (`static_reading` = read from the compiled game and paraphrased, no script text; `measured`; `reported` = a player's report, not a measurement of ours; `pending` = a placeholder ForgePact#31's Live procedure 1 fills; `not_observed`), `date`, `source` (one string `<path> § <section>`: the path is relative to the hub root and `section` is text that appears in that file; a Live capture under .claude/workorders/ is local and is only checked where it exists), `scripts` (every gml_Script_* the entry involves, all bound in hs_game_sdk.scripts.GameScript; may be empty), `objects` (every object the entry involves, all in hs_game_sdk.objects.OBJECT_NAME_TO_INDEX, with the index the SDK gives), `what` (the observation), `values`, `model` (what the model must show), optionally `hypothesis` (the HYPOTHESES key the entry answers) and `live_check` (the Live procedure 1 check that measures it), and exactly one of `reproduced_by` (the dotted id of the test that reproduces it) or `not_reproduced` (why it cannot be). DC1-DC5 are the static reading of 2026-10-03 (ForgePact#31's planning, a local Ghidra project of the current build; the decompiler output stayed on that machine). DC6 is Headhunter's measured kill path. DC7-DC10 are placeholders: ForgePact#31's Live procedure 1 replaces each with a measured entry (status `measured`, `values` filled, `source` the session's record) once the session has run.

measurements.what: Dungeon_Chest_obj owns five events: Create, Step, Draw, Alarm 0 and Other 7 (animation end). Found through the exe's YYGMLFuncs rows, so object events are readable statically although symbols.csv lists only scripts.
measurements.model: Not modelled: which events the chest owns is structure, not arithmetic. Recorded so a later build's reading can be compared with it.
measurements.not_reproduced: An event list is not a number the model computes; the test checks only that the object and its index are the SDK's.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC2, the Step counts nothing
measurements.what: The chest's Step calls, by name, GetKeyDungeonRoom, GetKeyDungeon, NetworkSendClientEffect, GPV, IsDefined and PlaySound3D. None of them counts or lists enemies.
measurements.model: The model takes the alive count as an input and does not say how the chest obtains it: chest_openable(alive) depends on nothing but alive.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC3, the open is the animation end
measurements.what: Other 7 (animation end) is the open: CreateInFreePos, an instance_create builtin call, SPV, ReturnSpecificStat, quest_exists, QuestComplete and CommunityQuestAddProgress. Alarm 0 calls ReturnSpecificStat and GPV; Create calls CheckTown, UpdateDepth and ReportClient.
measurements.model: Not modelled: the payout is out of ForgePact#31's scope and runs untouched.
measurements.not_reproduced: What the chest pays out is not what the model answers (when it may open); recorded so the mod's scope can be checked against it.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC4, the unlock condition is not visible statically
measurements.what: No body in this build calls a builtin directly (in 150 functions read only is_handle appeared as a direct call), and variables are read through slot ids, so an instance_number/instance_exists poll by the chest and the name of a variable it reads are both invisible statically: neither proven nor ruled out.
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['unlock_is_a_builtin_poll'] and HYPOTHESES['unlock_is_a_variable'] are both None.

measurements.what: Dungeon_Boss_Blocker_obj has Create/Step/Draw and its Step calls quest_exists and GPV. Spawn_Dungeon_obj (Create/Step/Alarm 0/Draw; Alarm 0 calls sc_rift, StringStartsWith, GPV and creates an instance) is the world-side entrance spawner of the special-content family, not a monster spawner. Dungeon_Spawner_1..4_obj have only a small Create.
measurements.model: Not modelled: whether anything adds monsters inside a dungeon after entry is DC8's live question.
measurements.not_reproduced: A static negative about spawners is not a measurement; HYPOTHESES['no_creators_in_dungeon'] stays None until DC8 is measured.

measurements.what: EnemyDestroyKillProc runs with the dying enemy as self and again with the player as self; Enemy_Death_Effect_obj is made on 50 of 307 kill-proc calls, so it is not a kill counter. Enemy_Parent_obj is the monster family.
measurements.model: Counting each enemy-self call once per instance id gives one kill per monster, and the model's population (kills + alive) stays constant as a monster moves from alive to killed.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC7, are all of a dungeon's monsters alive at entry?
measurements.what: Placeholder: the number of Enemy_Parent_obj descendants alive when the chest is first seen in a key dungeon (Pumpkin Cellar), and whether it equals the dungeon's whole population.
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['all_monsters_alive_at_entry'] is None until this entry is measured.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC8, are there creators inside a dungeon?
measurements.what: Placeholder: the number of Enemy_Creator_obj instances inside a key dungeon (creators-in-dungeon). More than zero is a Known Limitation of the mod, not solved by it.
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['no_creators_in_dungeon'] is None until this entry is measured.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC9, which variable flips when the last monster dies?
measurements.what: Placeholder: the chest or boss-blocker variable whose value changes at the last kill (unlock-signal), with its before and after values.
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['unlock_is_a_variable'] is None until this entry is measured.

measurements.source: docs/models/dungeon-chest-spec.md § DC10, does the chest's Step poll a builtin about monsters, and which?
measurements.what: Placeholder: whether the chest's Step calls a builtin about monsters (instance_number, instance_exists or another) and which, through the research build's builtin detours (builtin-poll).
measurements.model: HYPOTHESES['unlock_is_a_builtin_poll'] is None until this entry is measured.
